resources.string: Great! Planify has remembered your plans for today and will help you keep them in mind every 2 hours. You can add anything you want to the list – just type it above.
Hi there! Here you can write down all your grand (and not-so-grand) plans for today, and Planify will remind you about them every 2 hours. Oh, and of course, changing them later is a piece of cake!

Your plans can sync across all your devices! Just sign in with Google in one tap – and never forget your tasks anywhere.\n\nAll your data stays with you.
Plans and notes sync with your other devices through this Google account – everything is safe.
If the account you sign in to has saved plans or notes, they will overwrite what\'s saved on this device!\n\nWrite them down somewhere to move them to the account later.

It's simple: a prefix is one or more characters you enter before a line when editing your plan list to make that line an item you can mark as done. Completed items are marked with an asterisk (*) after the prefix.

You can use a prefix, for example, to separate plans from comments.

Notes is a place where you can leave anything, and what's saved here won't be deleted.
It can be something you need to remember or do, but not necessarily today.

Also, you can make several separate notes.
